        n0 = self.n0
        n1 = self.n1

        E_gaba = self.E_gaba

        tau_gaba = self.tau_gaba

        c_ampa = coupling[0, :]
        c_gaba = coupling[1, :]

        # Derived Variables
        self.integrating = integrating = np.where(np.greater(t_ref, 0), 0.0, 1.0)

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a

                integrating
                * (
                    I_e
                    + n0
                    + n1 * v
                    + n2 * v**2
                    - g_ampa * (v - E_ampa)
                    - g_gaba * (v - E_gaba)
                    - u / C
                )
            ),  # v
            np.asarray(a * integrating * (-u + b * (v - V_r))),  # u
            np.asarray(c_ampa - g_ampa / tau_ampa),  # g_ampa
            np.asarray(c_gaba - g_gaba / tau_gaba),  # g_gaba
            np.asarray(-1 + integrating),  # t_ref
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
